in_hebrew.name: גרוט
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Garrot is derived from the Hebrew word גרוט (garut), which means ‘rod’ or ‘staff’. This name was commonly given to boys in ancient times due to its strong association with strength and leadership.

in_greek.name: Γαρροτ
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Garrot in Greek is transliterated as Γαρροτ (Garrot), which also carries the meaning of ‘rod’ or ‘staff’. This name was popular in the Greek-speaking world and is found in various historical records.

in_latin.name: Garrottus
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin form of the name Garrot is Garrottus. This name also retains the meaning of ‘rod’ or ‘staff’, reflecting its Hebrew and Greek origins.
